# Obligement — Apollo port licensing and schedule report

- Original source: [Obligement — Apollo port licensing and schedule report](https://obligement.free.fr/articles/actuenbref11122025.php)
- Author / publication: Obligement; quoted Apollo Vampire Lair report
- Language / date: French; November–December 2025 roundup
- Access: Indexed relevant passage inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The roundup reproduces an Apollo Vampire Lair update explaining that negotiations with Microids had delayed the intended 1 December 2025 release of the Apollo V4/Amiga 68k port. It attributes slower progress partly to a change of contact and says the licensing discussions were expanded to Chicago 1930.

The reported target for Robin Hood shifted to the first quarter of 2026; Desperados was also discussed as a prospective related project.

**Historical scope:** these were plans reported in late 2025, not confirmation that any port subsequently shipped. Current availability remains unverified. The earlier developer interview already in this repository provides additional background through the [interview archive](../../interviews/README.md).

**Research use:** a dated account of porting and licensing developments distinct from the older MorphOS release.
